control_full_box.desc: Q,E,K all log-uniform 10^[-1,1]; PRO threshold rho>=0.8

pvs_conduit_bottleneck.desc: E,K >> Q so g>>Q; conduit is rate-limiting; proxy expected to hold

vascular_uptake_bottleneck.desc: K log-uniform 10^[-2.5,-1.5]; Q,E normal; named single-mechanism bottleneck

interstitial_exchange_bottleneck.desc: E log-uniform 10^[-2.5,-1.5]; Q,K normal; named single-mechanism bottleneck

_meta.model: steady-state series conductance: influx=Q*C0, g=E*K/(E+K), C_p=Q*C0/(Q+g), clearance=g*C_p
_meta.pe_substrate: Pe in [0.1,10] log-uniform, preserved across all regimes
